items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Actually, Cleo got that from him.

ctx.x: Do you remember what three strings he had with the three highs or the three hoes?

I really don't know. I know you could hear him. I'm telling you, you could hear him. Yeah. Yeah, you could hear him. Even with the bow. Oh yeah, with the bow. He used that bow. He used that bow. Actually, Cleo got that from him.
Cleo. Cleo used to use the bow. That's right. Cleo. Yeah, Cleo. The boys were right in New York.
